acceptance: New work cannot use a stale daemon/provider binding after lifecycle commit.
Captured backend, lease, memory, queue, payload, and owner references drain before retirement.
Replacement and same-owner rebind tests prove no duplicate retirement or old-generation admission.

lanes.outcome: Publish the explicit v1.0.0 compatibility surface with upgrade, reproducible-package, and cumulative v0.1.x regression closure on the AMD reference host.

DEB, RPM, and tar artifacts reproduce byte-for-byte from one clean revision with declared tool identities and no Nix runtime paths.
Cumulative milestone-0.1.0.0..0.1.3.0 regression and the generic install/upgrade/coexistence/removal matrices pass.
